I've answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random: the ticket is **#88412**.

I found it in #central-team, a channel Hollis belongs to. On 2 Jul 2025 Tobias raised #88412 there as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan. In the same thread he confirmed the ticket is for Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.

I didn't use `search_messages`. A ticket number is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share in the channel.
